message.title: Passing opportunity forward.
message.quote: I want to pass on the knowledge and experience I have gained through my connection with Japan, so that the next generation can use it to build a better future for Myanmar.
message.p1: I was born in Mandalay, Myanmar's second-largest city. My family was not wealthy, but people around me taught me Japanese, and later I gained work experience in Japan. Through continued connections with Japan, I have also learned from its culture and values.
message.p2: Having reached the age of 54, I believe it is time to pass the baton to a younger generation. Myanmar is still a developing country and many industries have yet to grow. I hope young people who go to Japan will return not only with earnings, but also with technology, skills and knowledge that can contribute to Myanmar's future.
message.p3: I hope our company's work can become one small part of that bridge.

hero.copy: Myanmar GSS supports candidates seeking employment opportunities in Japan through Professional Talent, Specified Skilled Workers and Technical Intern Training pathways.

pathways.copy: Our services are organized around three employment pathways. Available positions and sectors may vary according to employer requirements and recruitment cycles.

professional.label: PROFESSIONAL TALENT
professional.copy: Professional talent opportunities for foreign workers seeking employment in Japan under work-visa pathways.

ssw.label: SPECIFIED SKILLED WORKERS

hero.copy: A structured 15-step recruitment and employment-support process designed to guide candidates and Japanese employers from the first job order through post-arrival support.

intro.title: A clear path at every stage.
intro.copy: Each stage has a defined purpose, from receiving the employer's requirements to preparing candidates, completing required procedures, and supporting workers after arrival in Japan.

s1.label: Step 01
s1.title: Receive Job Order
s1.copy: Receive a job order and recruitment requirements from a Japanese employer.

s2.label: Step 02
s2.title: Job Announcement & Candidate Recruitment
s2.copy: Publish the job vacancy on our official page and begin recruiting suitable candidates.

s3.label: Step 03
s3.title: CV Collection & Document Screening
s3.copy: Collect candidates' CVs and required documents.

s4.label: Step 04
s4.title: In-House Japanese Conversation Test
s4.copy: Conduct a Japanese conversation (Kaiwa) test at our agency and select qualified candidates.

s5.label: Step 05
s5.title: CV Submission to Japan
s5.copy: Submit the CVs of candidates who pass our Agency's Kaiwa test to the Japanese employer for further consideration.

s6.label: Step 06
s6.title: Employer Interview
s6.copy: Arrange and conduct interviews between the selected candidates and the Japanese employer.

s7.label: Step 07
s7.title: Employment Contract
s7.copy: Successful candidates sign an employment contract with the Japanese employer.

s8.label: Step 08
s8.title: Demand Application
s8.copy: Submit the required demand documents to the relevant labor authorities in Myanmar.

s9.label: Step 09
s9.title: Certificate of Eligibility (COE) Application
s9.copy: Proceed with the Certificate of Eligibility (COE) application in Japan.

s10.label: Step 10
s10.title: Visa Application
s10.copy: Apply for the appropriate visa at the relevant visa application center.

s11.label: Step 11
s11.title: Standard Labor Contract
s11.copy: Complete the required labor contract procedures with the relevant labor authorities in Myanmar.

s12.label: Step 12
s12.title: OWIC Card Application
s12.copy: Apply for the Overseas Worker Identification Card (OWIC).

s13.label: Step 13
s13.title: Pre-Departure Orientation
s13.copy: Provide pre-departure orientation covering work conditions, workplace rules, life in Japan, and important information for living and working in Japan.

s14.label: Step 14
s14.title: Departure to Japan
s14.copy: Complete the final departure procedures and travel to Japan.

s15.label: Step 15
s15.title: Post-Arrival Support
s15.copy: Provide necessary support and follow-up assistance after the workers arrive in Japan.
